title: Cloud host: a WorkerAgent DO per attempt (harness + DO SQLite + watch/steer sockets); the door answers from it
description: Step 6, no flag: every cloud worker runs as a WorkerAgent DO with its tools in the attempt's FactorySandbox; the dispatch door's state/output/reclaim routes answer from it; hibernatable watch/steer WebSockets.
notes: 2026-10-04 18:03 - 2026-10-04 - run-epic-43y/tick-4fs/attempt-8: the between-rounds ready check landed in the checkpoint extension (tick 4fs) — this host MUST wire ensureReady: () => env.ensureWorkspaceReady() (and onRestore for its log) when it installs workspaceCheckpointExtension, or a container lost between rounds still boots empty and the round's file ops fail ENOENT. The residual boundary — a container lost DURING a round, under a file operation, where the run-door RPC has no loss signal — is this host's, which owns the container's lifetime and may call the public ensureWorkspaceReady()/restoreLostWorkspace() ahead of a round it knows the box under.
acceptance_criteria: a cloud attempt runs end to end on staging; door routes tested
